decisions.reason: Adding a beige body color does not change the required placard text.
The bowl-size clause confirms the already selected smaller bowl shown in the design and establishes no new size or geometry value.
The beige color choice does not alter the enclosure thickness, dimensions, or accommodation of the bowl wells.
The source changes appearance and confirms bowl size without changing mixing-quality or foam outcomes.
The body-color decision does not change the splash-control target.
Neither the beige color choice nor the bowl-size confirmation changes dispensing-path cleanability.
The source does not change the dispensing control mechanism, dripping constraint, or flow behavior.
The visual color change and bowl-size confirmation do not alter plumbing or seal requirements.
The source does not change the requirement to isolate electrical components from liquid.
Confirming the selected bowl size does not modify the independently required quick-removal and swapping behavior.
